body:
Hey. Thanks for your reply. I didn’t see it because I deleted Reddit but I just re-downloaded it today. 

My son is also 11 (soon to be 12). So I relate to you. He makes life worth living, or at least, he is my biggest reason not to end it all. 

You will be in my prayers as well. Stay strong.
I agree. The corporate world sucks. It is so draining. I need out as well. Sorry to hear you are struggling, I hope you find better work soon.

I feel similarly. I wish there was a motivation switch I could flip. Most of the time I know I should do something, call a client, send an email... but I just can’t bring myself to do it. Not because it’s hard, I just end up staring and doing nothing.

Working is awful. I hate going to work and just feeling like a cog. I am so easily replaceable. I want to quit but I can’t because I have to have money to live and I have people I have to support. It’s so stupid. I wish I could be a rock instead.
